## Download
- Desktop: macOS / Windows
- 3DS: SD-ready zip

## Quick install
1) Run InkLink Desktop and click Start.
2) Launch InkLink on 3DS from Homebrew Launcher.
3) Touch screen → preview dot should move.

## Notes / Known issues
- macOS: enable Accessibility permission
- Windows: allow through Firewall / try Admin if input blocked
